title: Agamemnon of Corinth
summary: Raleigh names Agamemnon of Corinth in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Agamemnon in Corinth liued with Amazia. He is not the Mycenaean Agamemnon. The one-word title would fold onto agamemnon, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXII, §. XII, sig. 334a
